title: Find Champion II
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2924); official page not retrievable
summary: Given n teams and directed edges [a, b] meaning a is stronger than b, return the unique champion (no stronger team), or -1 if there is not exactly one.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 100; 0 <= edges.length <= n*(n-1)/2; each edge has two endpoints in [0, n-1]; no self-loops; strength is antisymmetric and transitive.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps n at 24 teams (graph view limit). Difficulty Medium is from a search snippet.
